summary: TOOL-4 Filter products by category and brand
description:
As a customer, I want to filter so I can narrow down the catalogue.

* Selecting one category → only products from that category appear.
* Selecting two categories → products from both appear.
* Combining a category and a brand → only products matching both appear.
* Unchecking all filters → the full list returns.

criteria.text: Selecting one category → only products from that category appear.
Selecting two categories → products from both appear.
Combining a category and a brand → only products matching both appear.
Unchecking all filters → the full list returns.

cases.title: Selecting a single category shows only that category's products
cases.preconditions: The catalogue page is open with no filters applied. The catalogue contains products in at least two categories (e.g. 'Shoes' and 'Bags'), with at least two products in 'Shoes'.
steps: Note the products currently listed in the catalogue and their categories.
cases.expected: Only products belonging to the 'Shoes' category appear in the list; no products from any other category are shown.

cases.title: Selecting two categories shows products from both categories
cases.preconditions: The catalogue page is open with no filters applied. The catalogue contains products in at least three categories (e.g. 'Shoes', 'Bags' and 'Hats'), with at least one product in each.
cases.expected: Products from both the 'Shoes' and the 'Bags' categories appear in the list; products from other categories (e.g. 'Hats') are not shown.

cases.title: Combining a category and a brand shows only products matching both
cases.preconditions: The catalogue page is open with no filters applied. The catalogue contains: at least one 'Shoes' product of brand 'Nike', at least one 'Shoes' product of another brand, and at least one 'Nike' product in a different category.
cases.expected: Only products that are both in the 'Shoes' category and of the brand 'Nike' appear. 'Shoes' products of other brands and 'Nike' products from other categories are not shown.

cases.title: Unchecking all filters restores the full product list
cases.preconditions: The catalogue page is open with no filters applied and the full product list is visible.
steps: Note the full list of products shown with no filters applied.
Select a category filter (e.g. 'Shoes') and a brand filter (e.g. 'Nike') so that the list is narrowed down.
Uncheck the category filter 'Shoes' so that no filters remain selected.
cases.expected: With no filters selected, the full product list returns, matching the list noted in step 1.

cases.title: Unchecking all category filters after selecting two categories restores the full list
cases.preconditions: The catalogue page is open with no filters applied. The catalogue contains products in at least three categories (e.g. 'Shoes', 'Bags' and 'Hats').
steps: Note the full list of products shown with no filters applied.
Select the category filters 'Shoes' and 'Bags' and confirm products from both categories are shown.
Uncheck 'Bags' so that no filters remain selected.
cases.expected: After step 2 products from both selected categories appear; after step 4, with no filters selected, the full product list returns, matching the list noted in step 1.

cases.title: Category and brand combination with no matching products
cases.preconditions: The catalogue page is open with no filters applied. The catalogue contains a category 'Bags' and a brand 'Nike', but no product that is both in 'Bags' and of brand 'Nike'.
cases.expected: No products are shown, since only products matching both the category and the brand may appear and none match. The exact empty-result message or display is not specified in the story.
